stories.headline: Grenada returns Dickon Mitchell for a second term
stories.summary: Grenadians voted on 5 November to fill all 15 seats in their House of Representatives. The National Democratic Congress was returned to office, giving Dickon Mitchell a second consecutive term as prime minister. The opposition New National Party leader, Emmalin Pierre, lost her own seat.

stories.headline: LIV Golf winds up after five seasons
stories.summary: LIV Golf, the breakaway men's golf tour, has ceased operations after five seasons and will liquidate its assets. Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, which financed the tour from the start, withdrew its support in April, and a rescue plan from the investment firm BC Partners then fell through.

stories.headline: A companion star is ploughing through Betelgeuse
stories.summary: Betelgeuse, the red supergiant on the shoulder of Orion, appears to have a small companion star moving through its outer atmosphere. Radio measurements gathered between 2021 and 2026 show the giant star stretching and rounding in step with where that companion, Siwarha, is expected to be. The wider atmosphere has also warmed back to normal since the Great Dimming of late 2019 and early 2020.
